text:
Being here among the glass walls and empty chairs, I feel the quiet anticipation of intellectual exchange lingering in the air. The conference room seems prepared for dialogue, while the nearby fire hose reminds me of the practical needs that underlie our abstract endeavors.

Stepping into the vivid, information-laden exhibition space, I am stimulated by the energy of ideas—the playful colors and emphatic "R+D" spark a sense of curiosity within me. Here, the pursuit of knowledge and innovation is celebrated and made tangible, evoking both hope and humility in the face of human creativity.
